Preserve local auth-witness activity separately rather than demand zero witnesses for arbitrary simulation failures.

Restore the same listener and require actual readiness plus exact private name recovery without new proof/send. Preserve an intentional prepared intent, or cancel it explicitly only after healthy recovery. Do not recreate a hidden alternate endpoint.

For live staleness, pause only the disposable node synchronization/feed through supported controls and let its real synced timestamp age beyond the configured bound while ordinary public reader remains responsive. Do not forge timestamp/state or pass nowSeconds. Observe real STALE or sanitized UNAVAILABLE at the gateway, zero personalized upstream forward after failed readiness, zero proof/send/fallback, then resume and prove exact canonical recovery. A stricter gateway lag setting can shorten a clearly labelled configured-bound test; default120-second qualification needs actual120-second aging.

Exercise failure after readiness but before a personalized response using the same fault seam to cover the snapshot race; downstream must fail without redirect/fallback. Do not describe initial readiness failure alone as mid-operation evidence.

If claiming actual uncertain-send recovery under endpoint loss, use a separate bounded one-genuine-action variant: upstream accepts exactly one original sendTx, front response is dropped once, save intent/hash/fence, restore and reconcile the exact canonical transaction without any second send/new intent. Existing mocked journal evidence does not by itself prove this live boundary. Do not replay to obtain a receipt.
